entities.summary: Eswatini is a sovereign nation in Southern Africa, Africa. Its capital is Mbabane (administrative) / Lobamba (royal and legislative). Official languages include siSwati (Swazi), English. Government: Unitary parliamentary absolute diarchy (monarchy). Population: approximately 1.2 million. Area: 17,364 km². Comprehensive index for Eswatini covering Nguni migration, Dlamini dynasty, Mswati II expansion, British protectorate (Swaziland), independence 1968, Mswati III absolute monarchy (last absolute monarch in Africa), Reed Dance ceremony, and pro-democracy protests.
